description: Explore the databases, tables, views and columns behind an agent — keys, relationships, statistics, samples and what the ontology knows about each object — through a direct database connection or the agent's MCP tools

tool_definition.name: TDA_DatabaseNavigator
tool_definition.description: Explores database objects (databases, tables, views, columns, keys, relationships, statistics). Call 'describe' before writing SQL against a table you have not seen this session; 'search' to find an object or column by name; 'preview' for sample rows; 'suggest_joins' for the declared and inferred join paths of a table; 'open' to open the navigator panel for the user.[[gate:navigator_query]] 'query' runs ONE read-only SELECT (the 'sql' argument) against one of this agent's allowed database connections and returns its rows; on a MongoDB connection it runs one read-only aggregation ('collection' + 'pipeline') instead.[[/gate]]

database.description: Database (schema) name. Required for describe/preview/suggest_joins; optional for search/open.[[gate:navigator_query]] For query on a MongoDB connection that spans several databases: the database to aggregate in.[[/gate]]

object_name.description: Table or view name. Required for describe/preview/suggest_joins.

query_text.description: For search: the object or column name (or part of it) to look for — one identifier, not a question.

limit.description: Row limit for preview (default 20, max 200) or hit limit for search (default 20).[[gate:navigator_query]] For query: rows returned to you (default 100, max 500).[[/gate]]

sql.description: [[gate:navigator_query]]For query: exactly ONE read-only SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) in the connection's SQL dialect. Writes, several statements and DDL are refused.[[/gate]]

collection.description: [[gate:navigator_query]]For query on a MongoDB source: the collection to aggregate.[[/gate]]

pipeline.description: [[gate:navigator_query]]For query on a MongoDB source: the aggregation pipeline, a list of stages ($match, $group, $sort, $project, $unwind, $lookup, $limit, ...). Stages that write ($out, $merge) or run JavaScript ($function, $accumulator, $where) are refused.[[/gate]]

source_id.description: Optional catalog source id (from a previous result's 'source'). Omit to use the agent's resolved source.

intensity_tooltips.medium: Describe an object before querying it when its columns are unknown
intensity_tooltips.heavy: Always describe before SQL; search first when a name is uncertain; surface join paths
